run_human_pose_detection: run the HumanPose handler on an RGBDepth image to detect humans and their keypoints
create_human_keypoints_detector: create a HumanKeypoints detector using Detectron2 to estimate COCO keypoints from an image
build_human_world_object: build a Human WorldObject from RGBDepth data and detected keypoints for spatial reasoning
review_human_keypoints_ordering: review the HumanKeypointsOrdering namedtuple that maps 17 COCO person keypoints by name
test_human_to_struct: test the Human to_struct method to serialize xyz coordinates and keypoints as a dictionary
